name: Anxiety And Depression
overview: Scripture acknowledges the heaviness and fear that come with anxiety and depression but consistently points believers to trust and courage rooted in God's presence and strength. God commands His people to be strong and not afraid, assuring them of His constant support and help, as seen in Joshua 1:9 and Isaiah 41:10, 13. The Word encourages trusting the Lord wholeheartedly rather than leaning on human understanding, and it reminds us that God's comforting words bring gladness to the heart even amid many troubling thoughts, as expressed in Psalms 94:19 and Proverbs 3:5, 12:25.
